nodes.name: Every 1 min
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Chat poll. Fires every 60s (config.chat.poll_interval_s documents intent; n8n cron can't read it dynamically). Lists the channels the bot is a member of, scans for new @-mentions of the bot, enqueues one job per mention. Chat is poll-only (no webhook), so latency ~= 1 interval. ACTIVATE only after the end-to-end DoD passes.

nodes.name: Run now (manual)
nodes.notes: Manual harness (the Schedule Trigger can't be fired via API). Same downstream path.

parameters.formDescription: Press submit to poll bot chat channels for new @-mentions and enqueue.

nodes.name: Stamp Heartbeat
nodes.notes: Liveness heartbeat for the dead-man's switch (CU Chat Poll Freshness Monitor): upsert config.chat_poll_producer.last_run_at=now(). First in the chain so it stamps that the CRON FIRED, regardless of downstream API success. onError continueRegularOutput so a DB blip never blocks the poll (a missed stamp self-heals next minute).

parameters.query: insert into config (key, value) values ('chat_poll_producer.last_run_at', now()::text) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value;

nodes.name: Read Queue Flag
nodes.notes: ADR-056: read config.queue.enabled once to choose enqueue vs synchronous fallback. onError continueRegularOutput + retry -> a DB blip passes through with no value -> Queue Enabled? false -> synchronous Run Agent Spine (fail-safe to the known-good path).

parameters.query: select value from config where key = 'queue.enabled' limit 1;

nodes.name: List Bot Channels
nodes.notes: GET v3 chat channels as the bot (its token only sees channels it is a member of = membership scope). Returns {data:[...], next_cursor}. onError continueRegularOutput + retry -> a ClickUp blip degrades to an empty channel set (no candidates), never throws.

nodes.name: Read Cursors
nodes.notes: Read all per-channel last-seen cursors. alwaysOutputData so 0 rows still emits an item to drive Plan Per Channel; onError continueRegularOutput -> a DB blip degrades to no cursors (every channel treated cold-start -> seeds without replay, no spurious enqueues).

parameters.query: select channel_id, last_seen_ms, last_message_id from chat_poll_cursor;

nodes.name: Plan Per Channel
nodes.notes: Emit one item per bot channel {channel_id, last_seen_ms (number or null=cold-start)}, joining List Bot Channels (body.data) with the cursor rows. Drives the per-channel message fetch.

nodes.name: Fetch Channel Messages
nodes.notes: Per channel: GET recent messages (newest-first) as the bot. Returns {data:[{id,content,user_id,date,type,replies_count}], next_cursor}. onError continueRegularOutput + retry -> a per-channel blip yields no messages for that channel this poll (cursor unchanged, retried next minute), never throws. Item order is preserved 1:1 with Plan Per Channel for the index join in Process Channels.

nodes.name: Process Channels
nodes.notes: Index-join Plan Per Channel <-> Fetch Channel Messages (1:1, executionOrder v1). Per channel: candidates = messages with date > cursor AND not bot-authored; advance cursor to the newest message date seen. COLD START (no cursor row): seed cursor to newest WITHOUT enqueuing (don't replay history). Emits _kind=candidate items (-> mention gate) and one _kind=cursor item per channel (-> Upsert Cursor).

nodes.name: Route Kind
nodes.notes: _kind=candidate (true) -> mention gate; _kind=cursor (false) -> Upsert Cursor.

nodes.name: Fetch Tagged Users
nodes.notes: Per candidate: GET the message's tagged users (the authoritative mention signal — message text @Name is unreliable). Returns {data:[...], next_cursor}. onError continueRegularOutput + retry -> a failed fetch yields no tags -> treated as not-mentioned (rare miss, recovered nowhere this poll; retry reduces it). Item order preserved 1:1 with the candidate stream for the index join in Detect Bot Mention.

nodes.name: Detect Bot Mention
nodes.notes: Index-join the candidate stream (Process Channels candidates, same order) <-> Fetch Tagged Users. Keep candidates whose tagged_users include the bot (99811284). Defensive id read: object {id|user_id|user.id} or a bare id. Emits one item per real bot mention.

nodes.name: Claim Message
nodes.notes: Idempotency claim on the message id (ADR-066). INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; returns is_first. Exactly-once even across overlapping polls. onError continueRegularOutput + retry -> a DB blip fails OPEN (is_first undefined -> proceeds; the per-channel cursor still bounds re-scan).

parameters.query:
with ins as (
  insert into agent_chat_dedup (message_id, channel_id)
  values ($1, $2)
  on conflict (message_id) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (exists (select 1 from ins) or coalesce($1, '') = '') as is_first, $1 as message_id, $2 as channel_id, $3 as user_id, $4 as content;

nodes.name: Not Duplicate?
nodes.notes: is_first !== false -> proceed (true, incl. DB-error fail-open). is_first === false -> already claimed (overlapping poll) -> dead-end.

nodes.name: Queue Enabled?
nodes.notes: ADR-056: queue.enabled=true -> enqueue (true); else/unreadable -> synchronous Run Agent Spine (false).

nodes.name: Build Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: ADR-066 chat enqueue job. task_id null (chat keys on channel+message); top-level invocation_type=explicit_mention (consumer -> high-priority band, spine invocation 'explicit'); payload carries surface=chat + surface_ref{channel_id,message_id} + triggering_comment_text=message content + caller=author user_id (ADR-054 scope + ADR-064 spend gate). Keeps candidate fields at top level so the enqueue-failed branch reaches Run Agent Spine with the same shape.

nodes.name: Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: POST the job to the queue-consumer over the internal Docker network. onError continueErrorOutput -> a non-200/unreachable consumer routes to output 1 -> Alert Enqueue Failed (WARN) AND Run Agent Spine (synchronous fallback) so a claimed mention is never silently dropped.

nodes.name: Run Agent Spine
nodes.notes: Synchronous fallback (queue disabled OR enqueue failed). Calls the Agent Orchestrator inline with chat inputs. surface_ref passed as a JSON string (convertFieldsToString) — the chat reader parses it. Reads candidate fields from the item (present on both the queue-off Not Duplicate? item and the enqueue-failed Build Enqueue Job item).

nodes.name: Alert Enqueue Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when /enqueue fails; the run still proceeds via the synchronous Run Agent Spine fallback.

value.message: Nie udało się dodać wzmianki z czatu do kolejki — fallback do synchronicznego uruchomienia spine.

nodes.name: Upsert Cursor
nodes.notes: Advance the per-channel last-seen cursor (one item per channel). GREATEST guards against a stale lower value from an out-of-order/partial poll. Runs every poll for every channel (incl. cold-start seed + zero-mention channels) so the scan window never re-fetches old messages. onError continueRegularOutput so a write blip self-heals next poll.
